comparison.objective: Recover two stranded slot cars into active lanes without interrupting a protected circulating car.
comparison.physical_skill: Assigned-arm pick-and-place into moving constrained lanes with collision avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Each released car remains lane-engaged and travels 100 mm independently; any protected-car contact irreversibly zeros the score.
comparison.reason: Tests dynamic reinsertion and moving-obstacle avoidance, not tool impact, controlled fracture, or physical collection of released debris.
